# 后端工程师: own files

These are the files of the agent 后端工程师. If you are not working as that agent, hand the work to the sub-agent `acme-backend-developer` instead of using them.

## Own skills

In this skill's directory. Read the SKILL.md of the one that fits the work before you do it:

- `skills/api-development/SKILL.md`: 按团队的接口规范设计和实现 HTTP 接口。要新增或修改接口时使用。

## Working directories

In this skill's directory. What you write into them stays on this computer: updates of the agent do not touch it.

- `memory/`
- `workspace/`
